text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered — routing.fallback.high-error-rate in us-west-2. @ops-oncall paged. Incident ID INC-2026-342

morgan: Acknowledged. I'll take lead. Pulling logs now.

alice: seeing a spike of 500s from routing-service v2 behind the gateway. lots of \"model-not-found\" and \"fallback-selection-timeout\" in the logs.

raj: network metrics show increased cross-region egress from eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 starting ~18:05 UTC. possible spillover when us-west pools got saturated.

morgan: copy. attaching initial log tail.

morgan: ```
[18:06:12] routing-service ERROR fallback selector timed out for req=abcd1234 model=redwood-large-v1
[18:06:12] serve-gpu ERROR model-not-found: variant quantized-v2 not available on node node-gpu-7
[18:06:13] api-gateway WARN upstream 502 from routing-service (timeout)
```

alice: that model-not-found lines match a node-level mismatch after autoscale events. nodes came up without the quantized variant.

sam: confirming autoscaling logs — scale-up events at 18:04 and 18:05, but image warmup completed ~18:08. requests routed during warmup.

kevin: looks like fallback policy allowed cross-region fallthrough to us-west-2 and selected a cheaper variant that wasn't staged on new nodes. policy config snippet: 

kevin: ```json
{"tier": "standard", "fallback_order": ["regional_same_model", "cross_region_cost_optimal", "lower_precision_variant"], "max_cross_region_qps": 200}
```

morgan: immediate mitigation: 1) disable cross_region_cost_optimal fallback (throttle to 0) 2) enable strict regional_same_model preference 3) increase routing retry window to allow nodes to finish warmup. Doing step 1 now.

morgan: `curl -X PATCH https://controlplane/api/v1/policies/routing -d '{"fallback_order":["regional_same_model","lower_precision_variant"],"max_cross_region_qps":0}'`

deploy-bot: policy patch accepted (change-id ch-889). New policy active in control-plane at 18:12 UTC.

tay: on-call handoff incoming in 20m — I'll follow up after I get up to speed. @morgan if you want to delegate next rotation ping me.

morgan: noted. tay — please take next 2hr rotation at 18:30, I'll draft the initial timeline and hypothesis list.

morgan: short customer impact summary: ~4% request failures for standard tier globally; eu region saw elevated latencies (p95 +600ms) and 1-2% increased error rates for a set of mid-late traffic customers. No data exfiltration.

alice: adding stacktrace sample that points to selector trying to load quantized-v2 but failing artifact fetch: 

alice: ```
Error: ArtifactNotFound: s3://models/redwood-large-v1/quantized-v2/model.bin not found
 at artifact_loader.js:45:12
 at async loadModelVariant (model_manager.js:78:5)
```

raj: hypothesis list (initial):
1) autoscaler fast-path routed traffic to new nodes before model artifacts were staged (warmup gap)
2) fallback policy allowed cross-region cost-optimal variants that weren't present on new nodes -> model-not-found -> 502s
3) regional capacity imbalance triggered excessive spillover, amplifying the issue

morgan: adding operational notes: timeline markers saved at https://logs.redwood/INC-2026-342 (internal link). please upload any local dumps to that bucket with prefix /incidents/1791002468/

sam: uploaded node startup logs to the incident bucket (s3://incidents/1791002468/nodes_startup.tar.gz). includes kubelet events and model cache status.

kevin: quick mitigation follow-ups: suggest making artifact precheck part of node readiness so routing only sends traffic post artifact fetch. also we should consider a conservative default for fallback_order for reserved capacity customers.

morgan: agree. creating TODOs: 
- Add readiness probe to check model artifact presence (owner: alice)
- Add pre-warm hook in autoscaler to fetch variants before traffic (owner: sam)
- Revise fallback_order defaults and tier overrides (owner: kevin)

morgan: I'll open a post-incident RCA doc and assign owners. tay — handing off active rotation to you at 18:30. full context in this thread.

tay: taking rotation. thanks. I'll monitor for 30m then escalate if error rates don't fall under 0.5%. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 status: mitigation in progress. current error rate (last 5m): 0.9% (down from 4.0%), cross-region traffic reduced ~72%.

morgan: closing real-time mitigation — policy change held, errors trending down. we'll move to postmortem/RCAs and schedule a follow-up sync with product + dedicated customers.

kevin: note for RCA: include perf regression risk when suggesting defaulting to lower_precision_variant for cost-savings. some customers rely on precision-sensitive models.

morgan: thanks team. I'll create the RCA draft and link it here once created.

morgan: RCA draft link: https://docs.redwood/internal/rca/INC-2026-342 (DRAFT) — will populate timeline, evidence (logs + traces), and action items.

raj: leaving final note — check routing table TTLs; we saw stale entries for ~90s that may have accelerated misroutes. adding to RCA.

tay: acknowledged. I'll run a quick query for TTL anomalies and post results in the RCA doc.

morgan: end of thread for live mitigation — switching to RCA coordination in the doc. everyone, please add any missed evidence to the incident bucket.
